mentions.name: PlantLab
mentions.description: This API delivers AI plant health diagnosis for cannabis: photo in, structured JSON out with condition, confidence, growth stage, and nutrient lockout analysis, with responses designed for machines rather than humans (e.g., a controller dims lights on light burn, a dosing pump adjusts on a flagged lockout). It runs a ViT-based multi-stage pipeline - cannabis verification, condition/pest classification, then nutrient subclassification if needed - covering 30 classes at 18ms inference, served by a Go API on ONNX Runtime and trained on over a million images from growers. A Home Assistant integration takes scheduled camera snapshots and acts on the diagnosis with no human involved, and a simple Android app on Google Play lets people try it out (iOS planned). Solo project with under 100 users; free tier is 3 diagnoses per day.
mentions.problem: Cannabis grow rooms are already full of automation - VPD controllers, pH/EC monitoring, dosing pumps, dimmable lights - but nothing looks at the plant: every sensor measures the environment, not whether the plant is actually doing well.
mentions.audience: Cannabis growers with automated grow rooms.
